---
title: "SD Components vs Population Size"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggExtra)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

res <- readRDS(here("results", "model_fits.rds"))
boot_results <- read.csv(here("data", "boot_results.csv"), header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
pop_89 <- read.csv(here("data", "89_pop.csv"), header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
pop_89 <- pop_89["Jul.89"]
```

```{r}
#| label: build-table

state_bfgs_table = as.data.frame(t(res$state_bfgs))
samp_var = boot_results$e0.var
state_bfgs_table = cbind(state_bfgs_table, samp_var)
state_bfgs_table = state_bfgs_table %>%
  mutate(shock_sd = var_obs - samp_var) %>%
  mutate(var_innov = sqrt(var_innov), var_obs = sqrt(var_obs), samp_var = sqrt(samp_var), shock_sd = sqrt(shock_sd))
colnames(state_bfgs_table) = c("drift", "process_SD", "observation_SD", "sampling_SD", "shock_SD")
```

```{r}
#| label: merge-population

pop_89_for_figure = subset(pop_89, !(rownames(pop_89) %in% c("US", "DC")))
pop_89_for_figure = pop_89_for_figure / 1e6
state_table_for_figure = cbind(state_bfgs_table, pop_89_for_figure)
state_table_for_figure = as.data.frame(state_table_for_figure)
state_table_for_figure[] = lapply(state_table_for_figure, function(x) as.numeric(x))
# remove states with 0 observation variance
state_table_for_figure = subset(state_table_for_figure, state_table_for_figure$observation_SD >= 0.000000001)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-process-sd
#| fig-cap: "Process SD vs Population Size"

p1 <- ggplot(state_table_for_figure, aes(x = Jul.89, y = process_SD)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0, 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Population Size (In Millions)", y = "Standard Deviation in Years", title = "(a) Process Standard Deviation")
ggExtra::ggMarginal(p1, type = "histogram", margins = "y")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-observation-sd
#| fig-cap: "Observation SD vs Population Size"

p2 <- ggplot(state_table_for_figure, aes(x = Jul.89, y = observation_SD)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0, 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Population Size (In Millions)", y = "Standard Deviation in Years", title = "(b) Obs. Standard Deviation")
ggExtra::ggMarginal(p2, type = "histogram", margins = "y")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-sampling-sd
#| fig-cap: "Sampling SD vs Population Size"

p3 <- ggplot(state_table_for_figure, aes(x = Jul.89, y = sampling_SD)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0, 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Population Size (In Millions)", y = "Standard Deviation in Years", title = "(c) Sampling Standard Deviation")
ggExtra::ggMarginal(p3, type = "histogram", margins = "y")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-shock-sd
#| fig-cap: "Shock SD vs Population Size"

p4 <- ggplot(state_table_for_figure, aes(x = Jul.89, y = shock_SD)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0, 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Population Size (In Millions)", y = "Standard Deviation in Years", title = "(d) Shock Standard Deviation")
ggExtra::ggMarginal(p4, type = "histogram", margins = "y")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-combined
#| fig-cap: "Process and Observation SD vs Population Size"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

p1_plain <- ggplot(state_table_for_figure, aes(x = Jul.89, y = process_SD)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0, 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Population Size (In Millions)", y = "Standard Deviation in Years", title = "(a) Process Standard Deviation")

p2_plain <- ggplot(state_table_for_figure, aes(x = Jul.89, y = observation_SD)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, col = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0, 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Population Size (In Millions)", y = "Standard Deviation in Years", title = "(b) Obs. Standard Deviation")

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1_plain, p2_plain, ncol = 2)
```
